set.body:
Run the packaged service and a digest-pinned private Neurobagel stack. From a normally accepted synthetic release, preview, approve and publish the exact artifact. Check expected aggregate matches and non-matches, a fixed link and both permitted and denied access. Replace then withdraw. Probe fresh query, metadata and facet requests after withdrawal and restart. Retain CLI, service and node identities, artifact digests, generation receipts and query evidence. This is the WP-16 exit. Validate conformance for the consumed HTTP routes as part of INT01.

Source: docs/implementation-plan.md, External discovery through Neurobagel.
set.title: NB03: Rehearse aggregate discovery, replacement and withdrawal on a private node
